ChatGPT & Codex Changelog

  • GPT-5.5 retires from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on October 14

    On October 14, 2026, GPT-5.5 will retire from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on all plans. This does not apply to the OpenAI API.

  • GPT-5.4 retires from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in

    GPT-5.4 retires from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on August 31, 2026.
